summary: Model updated for RaftMsg::TransferLeader and the lease flag; harness rebased; 20 fresh traces validated. Two reproduced findings: MC-1 (update-introduced learner-target panic) and MC-2 (pre-existing leader self-election assertion panic, new trigger).
validation_limits: All bounded TLC campaigns without a counterexample stopped at their 30-minute budget with non-empty queues (LIMITED_COVERAGE).
Lease time, follower conflict truncation, follower commit propagation, and snapshots remain abstracted.
No real trace of an absent (removed) transfer target or of crash/restart across a transfer.
MC-2 consequence reproduced only with debug assertions; release-build behavior not verified.
Novelty of findings not assessed: external issue search is prohibited by the isolation contract.

findings.title: transfer_leader to a learner makes the learner run an election and panics its RaftCore
findings.cause: The RaftMsg::TransferLeader handler calls Engine::elect() for to == self.id without the is_voter guard used by the other elect() callers; a learner candidate then grants itself and Candidate::grant_by panics because its progress holds voters only.
findings.trigger: Call Raft::transfer_leader(leader_vote, learner_id, last_log_id) on the cluster nodes (as documented) with a caught-up learner as the target.
findings.consequence: The learner's RaftCore panics (Fatal::Panicked) and the voters, whose leases the transfer disabled, grant the learner's higher vote, deposing the healthy leader until an election timeout.

premises: A learner holds the leader's committed vote after replication.
The public transfer_leader API forwards a TransferLeader message to the target without validating that it is a voter.
SaveVote delivers the self vote response before any remote response on the FIFO notification channel.

findings.title: A Leader that runs elect() trips the leader_handler vote-order assertion (transfer to the current leader)
findings.cause: Engine::elect() on a node that is already Leader keeps its Leader object while moving the local vote to a higher non-committed vote; Engine::leader_handler() debug-asserts leader.committed_vote >= state.vote and RaftCore calls it every loop iteration.
findings.trigger: Call Raft::transfer_leader(leader_vote, current_leader_id, ..) (new) or Raft::trigger().elect() on the leader (pre-existing).
findings.consequence: With debug assertions enabled the leader's RaftCore panics (Fatal::Panicked) and the cluster loses its leader until an election timeout; release-build behavior not verified.

premises: Builds with debug assertions (openraft's test configuration).
Neither the TransferLeader handler nor ExternalCommand::Elect rejects elect() on a Leader.
